title: AIDSO stages protest in support of ASHA workers in Dharwad

ai.summary: Students from AIDSO staged a protest in Dharwad supporting ASHA workers who have been on indefinite strike since November 15 demanding ₹15,000 monthly honorarium.

facts.claim: Students under the aegis of All India Democratic Students’ Organisation (AIDSO) staged a protest at Vivekananda Circle in Dharwad on Saturday
facts.quote: Students under the aegis of All India Democratic Students’ Organisation (AIDSO) staged a protest at Vivekananda Circle in Dharwad on Saturday

facts.claim: urging the State government to fulfil the demands of ASHA workers who have been on an indefinite strike in Bengaluru
facts.quote: urging the State government to fulfil the demands of ASHA workers who have been on an indefinite strike in Bengaluru

facts.claim: thousands of ASHA workers had been staging an indefinite protest at Freedom Park in Bengaluru since November 15
facts.quote: thousands of ASHA workers had been staging an indefinite protest at Freedom Park in Bengaluru since November 15

facts.claim: Accusing the Congress government of failing to honour its assurance of increasing their monthly honorarium to ₹10,000 two years ago
facts.quote: Accusing the Congress government of failing to honour its assurance of increasing their monthly honorarium to ₹10,000 two years ago

ai.background_note: ASHA workers, who provide grassroots healthcare, have been on indefinite strike since November 15 demanding ₹15,000 monthly honorarium, with AIDSO supporting their cause.
